company.description: Brumby AI develops software for contact centers. Its offerings include speech analytics, automated quality assurance, workforce management, e-learning, gamification, conversational AI agents, dashboards, and AI-supported mentoring. The company provides tools for managers, supervisors, analysts, and contact-center agents to analyze conversations, manage schedules, access operational information, support training, and monitor performance.
